propositions: infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh recreates the compose-review-bot-1 container without draining in-flight reviews, killing uvicorn mid-review and preventing vote submission

the review reconciler (reconcile_loop) awaits review_and_vote inline outside the graceful shutdown queue, so it is killed within SHUTDOWN_CANCEL_SECONDS when the container is recreated, breaking the self-heal retry path
during landing bursts with deploy gaps shorter than review duration, reviews are repeatedly killed before voting, causing the LLM-Review gate to live-lock while all health signals remain green
the bot's existing graceful shutdown (queue.join with 1200s timeout, 1320s stop_grace_period) protects webhook-queued reviews but not the reconciler path that handles retries

autodeploy now defers recreation if the bot reports in_flight > 0, bounded by DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX=1800s keyed to the deferral episode rather than target SHA, with new observability tokens AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED and AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT
